stdout:
Build kit for "Bottom Sheet - Review flow"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        form-wizard
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Linear multi-step form that moves through one panel at a time, with a horizontal progress track pinned above rather than running down a rail, so every step keeps the full content width for its fields.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template form-wizard --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: form-wizard (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        BottomSheetSwitcherReviewFlow
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A two-step form flow of two standalone sheets driven by one state value: Continue replaces the review step with the confirmation in place, and Back returns.

name:        BottomSheetNoScrim
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Keeps the page visible and interactive behind a non-modal bottom sheet.

name:        BottomSheetHeights
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Compares hug, capped, and tall starting heights for different amounts of content.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 6; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        BottomSheet
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A mobile touch surface for filters, actions, forms, and detail views that should rise from the bottom of the viewport.

name:        BottomSheetSwitcher
package:     @astryxdesign/core
deprecated:  use BottomSheet: Write each step as its own BottomSheet with isOpen, controlled by one state value that names the open step; moving on from inside the open step replaces it in place (see BottomSheet, Replacing a sheet). BottomSheetSwitcher keeps working until a future minor release removes it.
description: Deprecated: write each step as its own BottomSheet with isOpen, controlled by one state value that names the open step.

name:        ChatLayout
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: ChatLayout is the layout shell for full-page chat interfaces.
